name: garmin-cn-sync
description: Local-first, read-only Garmin China data sync for Codex and ChatGPT

interface.shortDescription: Sync and query Garmin China data locally.
interface.longDescription: Local-only, read-only Garmin China connector. Garmin credentials stay in the user's operating-system credential store and health data stays in a local SQLite database.
defaultPrompt: 同步我的 Garmin 中国区数据并总结最近一周。
分析最近 28 天睡眠、HRV 与静息心率趋势。
列出最近一个月的跑步活动。
